comments.value:
"Or co-operate with companies, EAC have security issue. EAC requires full access to our computers, which means EAC resembles malware. Companies are worried with security issue."
Which firms won't work with a company because their game has anti-cheat? It's standard for most multiplayer games, and isn't malware. Even in highly secure environments the mitigation for such a risk would be to issue a second company machine (without intranet/VPN access) to those who need it, not refuse the work.
"VRChat inc. often say "we, developers" or "we creators" that means we are "trusted", but EAC changes all. EAC means "VRChat cannot trust us, and we are not developer". I confused, and sad with this "statement"."
I don't think 'developer' or 'creator' means 'trusted'. Developers and creators in VRChat are a wide community that anyone can be part of, there's no vetting process to prevent malicious behaviour like an internal employee. There are many malicious developers out there, unfortunately.
I would like to see private moddable instances and/or an API to help with lost features, that could enable debugging tools and some of the other legitimate uses for mods. It does suck that some of those features will be lost, even if I am happy about EAC on balance.

@{62e249588ec14e44ac1dce1e|full_name}: >>Which firms won't work with a...
well.......  companies include not game companies.
IDK US/EU, in Japan, ぎょくて is true.

@{62e249588ec14e44ac1dce1e|full_name}: First, I want to apologize for aggressive writing. "Not trusted" is not easily using words... And I'm sure that EAC concerning matters can be avoidable in the most cases, with adequate prepare. But sometimes hard than past.
>> Even in highly secure environments the mitigation for such a risk would be to issue a second company machine (without intranet/VPN access) to those who need it, not refuse the work.
It is almost "yes", I agree with. If we can, it is the true answer that set up testing machines isolated with secure systems. Which is various way we can do, physical machines, VM, sandbox environment, etc...
But EAC does not admit some VM or sandbox, and it is harder for us secure than past. frou01 also write that, there is various companies and individuals using VRChat for commercial use in Japan, and I think few can prepare for it. It is too fast to mount EAC on the service from announcement.
>> I would like to see private moddable instances and/or an API to help with lost features, that could enable debugging tools and some of the other legitimate uses for mods. It does suck that some of those features will be lost, even if I am happy about EAC on balance.
I completely agree with this. But it is some technical issue, about Unity or DirectX. Build test environment is not enough. For example, if debuging shader in the other's world, it is harder without hook application like Nsight or RenderDoc for detecting errors. I know developer build mode is Non-EAC, but VR Debug after building is still hard. I don't know EAC can exclude these software from observation. And now it is no, and this is the matter. 
If, with preparing, I can admit to install EAC in my computer. However, it is too fast and we cannot prepare. And debuging-friendly is still matter.

@{62e249588ec14e44ac1dce1e|full_name}: Finally, I was competely mistaken. Jamessuperfun was true and I was fool. It can solve by using VM, and EAC does not matter. And using debug such tools are completly ToS offensive. 
I'm very sorry for you and VRChat inc.

details:
With EAC, we creators cannot create what we want.  
VRChat, you said "Mod leads bugs", that's right. But we creators also struggle with it. We managed to know the behavior of our production, and if we have any bugs, we try hard to fix. (Even if it leads by mods...)
And many creators,(especially in Japan) get "creators economy", to buy avatars, gimmicks or collaborate with companies, by our indomitable effort.
However, EAC BREAKS THIS. 
First, EAC have strong constraint with processes, we creators cannot debug with external application. For example, to debug shaders, creators must use hook application to check. The result is clear, we cannot check shader, udon, and unity behavior. 
Or co-operate with companies, EAC have security issue. EAC requires full access to our computers, which means EAC resembles malware. Companies are worried with security issue. For example, sometimes companies have confidential informations and creator must contact NDAs. If with EAC, we creators cannot obey the clauses in NDAs, because of EAC's behaviour. Which means, creator lose earns. Creator economy is now dead by EAC.
 
I am Japanese and live in Japanese community. I have not to use mods. Ihate mods. BUT I DISAGREE WITH EAC. 
TO USE EAC, WE CANNOT CREATE, SHARE, PLAY. EAC MEANS WE CAN NOT BE CREATORS. VRChat inc. often say "we, developers" or "we creators" that means we are "trusted", but EAC changes all. EAC means "VRChat cannot trust us, and we are not developer". I confused, and sad with this "statement".
VRChat, it is not about mods probrem. but is creators "broken" lifeline. I just lose mamy creator friends, by EAC issue. I am sad, my friends also. Please remove EAC.
title: With EAC, CREATORS MUST DIE. PLEASE REMOVE EAC!!
